sources.summary: Celebrities including Charli xcx and Gabbriette and avant-garde brands honour tradition while also rejecting it If a wedding day brings to mind a bride dressed in a big white dress, the styles coming down the aisle in the near future may strike you as a little different. Whether it is through celebrity references, or new brands, wedding gowns are entering a more experimental era. For Charli xcx’s marriage to the 1975 drummer George Daniel last year, the bride wore a minidress and sunglasses . Continue reading...
